# Chroma

An open-source vector database used for local embedding generation and nearest-neighbor search.

## What creators claimed

- Used as the core storage engine and local embedding provider (via bundled all-MiniLM-L6-v2) to implement the semantic cache. ([DeVz6IUmNBq](../reels/DeVz6IUmNBq.md))
